meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: Claude 可以通过 lsp 工具调用语言服务器:查看已配置的语言服务器状态、检查某个文件或目录的诊断问题、跳转到定义、查找引用、列出符号,以及检查重命名是否有效并执行重命名。
howto.when: 当你需要语言服务器的诊断、定义或引用等结果,或做重命名安全检查时触发;若诊断提示缺少语言服务器,先调用 lsp.status 查看状态。

say.text: 用 lsp 检查这个文件有什么错误
say.note: lsp.diagnostics 会返回该文件的诊断结果

say.text: 找出这个函数在哪些地方被引用
say.note: lsp.find_references 在工作区内搜索该符号

say.text: 帮我把这个符号重命名,先判断是否安全

howto.what_en: Claude gains LSP tools: check language-server status, run diagnostics on a file or directory, jump to definitions, find references, list symbols, and validate then apply renames via the language server.
howto.when_en: Use when you need language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks. If diagnostics report a missing language server, run lsp.status first.

say_en.text: Use lsp to check this file for errors
say_en.note: lsp.diagnostics returns diagnostics for that file

say_en.text: Find where this function is referenced
Rename this symbol, checking safety first
